nodes.text: [They say that] a woman, having drawn a circle and set down the drugs, stepped into the circle, herself and her son, and then imitated the voice of the beast; and it sang back in answer and approached. As it sang, the woman fell asleep, and more so as it came nearer, so that she could not master her sleep.
